# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability edited: **system-prompt only** (`prompt.md`). No tools.py in this edit space, so all fixes are prompt/policy edits targeting recurring behavioral + knowledge failures of the sonnet-4-5 reader.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrote Excel FORMULA/macro into cells instead of computed literals → grader reads raw formula text / uncomputed serials → 0 | 40467 (formula in ~3/5 trials, all 0), 374-9 (3/5 trials), 32468 (t2) | Agent takes "use a formula / macro / VBA / SUMIFS / INDEX-MATCH" literally and stores a formula; old prompt only said "prefer" literals (too soft) | BEHAVIORAL (rule the agent has but skips) | Hard prohibition + rationale + worked example in prompt |
| 2 | Hardcoded structure (fixed row/col/category counts, fixed answer-range width) that only fits the sample file → fails the other 2 hidden test files | 53161 (filled only cats 1-9 though range is F..AE), 374-9, 418-29 (0.33), 52216 | Code is re-executed on 3 test spreadsheets w/ same layout, different sizes; agent hardcodes what it saw | KNOWLEDGE + BEHAVIORAL | Prompt rule: detect extent dynamically, match by header/label, never paste sample values |
| 3 | Type/format mismatch; ignores already-correct template cells in the answer range | 40467 (wants text "From 01-Jan to 05-Jan"), 52216 (C15:G15 already correct as template) | No guidance to match displayed type/format or reproduce template cells | KNOWLEDGE | Prompt rule on type/format + reproduce-template |
| 4 | Destructive rewrite of multi-sheet / offset workbooks | 347-49, 32468, 374-9 (multi-sheet) | Rebuilding a sheet from a DataFrame can drop sheets / shift layout | KNOWLEDGE | Conditional prompt rule (multi-sheet OR not-A1 → edit in place w/ openpyxl) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Rule-hardening + worked example (missing-rule made unmissable) | prompt.md | "Write COMPUTED LITERAL VALUES — never formulas or macros" section: explains grader reads stored values, forbids any `=`-string / VBA, reframes "formula/macro/SUMIFS/INDEX-MATCH" requests as "produce the RESULT", with a From/serial worked example. General to all tasks in this benchmark. | Yes — no passing trial ever wrote a formula; 47484 already computes literals |
| 2 | Generalization rule | prompt.md | "Make your code GENERAL" section: detect real last row/col, match by header/label, never hardcode counts or paste sample values. Targets partial-credit on hidden files. | Yes — 47484 already uses dynamic groupby; passing trials generalize |
| 3 | Type/format + template rule | prompt.md | "Match the expected data type and format": numbers stay numbers, `01`/date-text stay text; reproduce already-filled example cells in the range. | Yes — 47484 writes text "01" (consistent, no change) |
| 4 | Conditional preserve rule (discriminating condition, bounded) | prompt.md | "Preserve everything outside the target": ONLY when multi-sheet OR data not at A1, edit in place with openpyxl instead of rebuilding from a DataFrame. | Yes — 47484 is single-sheet, data at A1 → condition false → its pandas path is untouched |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- Cluster 1: trace 40467 t0 wrote `="From "&TEXT(B1,...)` → 0. New rule + worked example directly instructs to write literal `From 01-Jan to 05-Jan`. Passing 47484 writes no formula → rule does NOT alter its behavior.
- Cluster 2: trace 53161 t4 hardcoded categories 1-9 (result_col 6-14) though answer range is F22:AE29 (cols 6-31) → under-filled. Rule tells it to match every category column by scanning the range/headers. Passing 47484 uses dynamic groupby → unaffected.
- Cluster 3: trace 52216 t1 misread which column held expense names and produced wrong values while C15:G15 was already correct as a template → 0. Rule says reproduce the template row's computation/format. Passing 47484 (text "01") is consistent with the format rule → no change.
- Cluster 4: traces 347-49 / 32468 / 374-9 are multi-sheet; rule scopes in-place-openpyxl editing to multi-sheet/non-A1 only. 47484 is single-sheet at A1 → condition FALSE → keeps its `to_excel` path unchanged (verified from its inspection: shape (7,3), single 'Sheet1', header row1).

## Process & features used
- Serial analysis (no subagents): the trajectory set is small (10 tasks × 5 trials) and read directly with a few python passes; fan-out overhead not warranted.
- Prior iterations: none — this is the first iteration after the baseline seed (LEDGER shows baseline only; RUNMAP/prior_iterations empty). Nothing to build on or avoid yet.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The "no formulas / compute literals" hard rule + worked example — strongest signal in the traces.
- The conditional (not blanket) preserve rule: do NOT forbid pandas `to_excel` outright, or you regress single-sheet-A1 tasks like 47484.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457 (always 0): its `instruction` field is literally a non-breaking space (empty). With no stated intent the agent can only guess the fill semantics (it filled amount/0 into date columns; expected differs). Not fixable by a general prompt rule without hardcoding this task — skipped.
- 347-49 exact blank-row-deletion semantics: genuinely ambiguous ("delete all blank rows above each Gross Pay"); no general prompt rule reliably recovers the exact expected row set without overfitting. Partially aided by clusters 2/4 but not directly targeted.
